installNote.extension: Download the zip, then open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode and choose "Load unpacked" on the extracted folder.

installNote.tui: Paste this in a terminal, or run it without installing with npx wsb-tui.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This app counts visits without tracking you. No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers.
privacy.collectedEvent: Events such as switching the view or the period.
privacy.collectedDevice: Device class (mobile, tablet, desktop) and language.
privacy.collectedReferrer: The host of the website that referred you, if any.
privacy.notIdentity: No name, email, account or user identifier.
privacy.notCookies: No advertising cookies and no third-party trackers.
privacy.notAddress: No IP address and no full URL.
privacy.retentionBody: Raw events are kept for 90 days. After that only the daily totals remain.
privacy.session: Sessions are counted with a temporary identifier in the tab; it disappears when the tab closes.
